explanations.content: In Java, certain characters like double quotes, backslashes, newlines, and tabs cannot be placed directly inside string literals because the compiler interprets them specially. To include them, you must prefix the character with a backslash (\) which tells the compiler to treat the following character as a literal part of the string.
